Nigeria and Angola are showing strong signs of growing upstream momentum, while Namibia and Mozambique are emerging as two of the world's most closely watched growth stories. Together, these four markets are reshaping the outlook for Sub-Saharan Africa's oil and gas sector. Fiscal reforms, major project approvals and improving investment conditions are attracting capital back to the region, while world-class discoveries and LNG developments are opening up new long-term opportunities.
In this video, we explore the four markets driving Africa's upstream agenda, examine the projects and policy shifts attracting investment, and assess what Nigeria, Angola, Namibia and Mozambique mean for the region's next phase of growth and competitiveness.
